role: FDA copy-perimeter linter: scans Swift string literals and .xcstrings catalogue keys and stringUnit values under prohibited_terms.json scan_paths for regulated-claim regexes, plus multilingual neverInStaticCopy patterns from MedicalTermLexicon.swift over catalogues; exit 0 clean, 1 violations, 2 config/IO error. Run by Makefile:172 (copy-perimeter, in `make ci`), .github/workflows/ci.yml:154, .github/workflows/gates.yml:54 (via make) and scripts/verify_gates_fail.sh mutation checks.
types: Violation: dataclass — path/line/snippet/pattern/reason of one hit
MissingScanPath: Exception — configured scan path or lexicon section missing
toplevel: Module docstring; imports; Violation dataclass (40-46); INTERPOLATION_RE (190); _SENTENCE_END (277); MissingScanPath (409); LEXICON_PATH (413); `if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())` (586-587). Running it on main @ 8d32097 prints "copy_linter: clean. FDA perimeter holds." (exit 0) and all 12 neverInStaticCopy concepts parse.

units.does: Reads and parses the JSON config; exits the process with code 2 on missing file or JSON decode error.
Returns True when the repo-relative posix path starts with any allowlist_paths entry (prefix match so split sibling files like AIProvider+SystemPromptText.swift stay exempt).

branches.effect: True → main skips the file entirely; else False

units.does: Returns the source with /* */ block comments (non-nested, regex) and // line comments replaced by spaces, preserving line numbers. Used only to build the lines is_prohibition_context searches.
Regex callback: replaces every non-newline character of a matched block comment with a space.

Single-pass Swift lexer yielding (line, content) for every string literal: skips // and nestable /* */ comments, handles """ multi-line and #-delimited raw literals (no escape processing when hashes present), and single-line literals ending at the closing quote or newline.

branches.effect: walk nested depth to matching */ ; unterminated comment consumes rest of file
count hashes; if not followed by a quote skip them and continue, else treat as raw literal opener
multi-line: body up to closing """+hashes (or EOF if unterminated), yield, continue after closing

consume escape pair (so \( of an interpolation is consumed but the interpolation's inner quotes are not understood: a nested string literal in \(...) ends the outer literal early, re-phasing quotes for the rest of that line)
advance past it; else stop at newline (unterminated)

units.does: Converts a character offset to a 1-based line number by bisecting the newline offsets list.
Blanks Swift \(expr) interpolation spans to a space before matching. The regex stops at the first ")", so nested calls leave trailing text of the expression in the matched string.

Returns True when a guard regex matches in a 4-line window of the comment-stripped source (raw_lines[line-3:line+1] = the two lines above the literal's opening line, that line, and the line below) AND the first 40 chars of the snippet (whitespace and trailing punctuation stripped) appear in the sentence around the FIRST match of that guard; such strings are skipped for every pattern.

branches.effect: return True (string excused from every pattern); else continue; after all guards return False

units.does: True when the snippet, stripped of whitespace and trailing punctuation/quotes, is at least 3 chars and its first 40 chars occur inside the sentence.
Returns the substring of text between the last sentence terminator ([.!?\n]) before index and the next one at/after index.

branches.effect: start moves past it; none → start 0

units.does: Reads one Swift file, iterates its string literals, strips interpolations, and for each literal not in allowlist_strings and not excused by is_prohibition_context reports one Violation per matching pattern unless _forbidden_in_place excuses that match. Unreadable file → SystemExit(2).

branches.effect: skip this match; else append Violation with line offset of the match inside a multi-line literal

units.does: True when any negation guard matches inside the sentence (within the literal) containing the match offset.
Returns a whitespace-collapsed 120-char excerpt starting 40 chars before the match offset.

Parses an .xcstrings catalogue and reports a Violation (line 0) for each pattern matching a source key or a localization stringUnit value; a key in allowlist_strings also clears all its translations. Unparseable file → SystemExit(2).

branches.cond: value not a str (no stringUnit, e.g. plural/device variations)

units.does: Builds multilingual claim regexes from MedicalTermLexicon.swift: regex-extracts the identifiers in `static let neverInStaticCopy: [Concept] = [...]`, finds each `static let <name> = Concept(` block in the same file, collects its `latin:` (word-bounded) and `unbounded:` string arrays, and compiles one case-insensitive alternation per concept. Raises MissingScanPath if the array or every concept is missing.

branches.cond: Concept block not found in MedicalTermLexicon.swift (e.g. moved to a +Sibling file or formatted with different indentation)
branches.effect: silently continue — that concept is dropped from catalogue scanning

units.does: Nested helper: in the current concept body finds `<tag>: [`, bracket-matches to the closing `]` (handles one-line and multi-line arrays), strips // comments and returns the quoted strings with \\ unescaped to \.
Expands scan_paths to files: missing path → raise MissingScanPath; a file entry is added as-is; a directory contributes rglob("*.swift") and rglob("*.xcstrings").

branches.effect: append and continue (any extension; main ignores non-.swift/.xcstrings)

units.does: CLI entry: parses --root (default repo root from __file__) and --config, loads config, compiles user_facing_prohibited patterns (no implicit flags), builds translated patterns, compiles negation_guards, collects targets, skips allowlisted paths, runs scan_swift_file on .swift files and scan_xcstrings twice (English patterns, then translated patterns) on .xcstrings; prints "clean" and returns 0, or lists violations on stderr and returns 1; config/regex/path errors return 2. The JSON key coach_response_prohibited is never read here (used by scripts/check_perimeter_sync.sh).
units.entry: Invoked as a script via `python3 Tools/copy_linter/lint.py` from Makefile:172 (target copy-perimeter, part of `make ci` Makefile:272), .github/workflows/ci.yml:154, .github/workflows/gates.yml:54 (`make copy-perimeter ...`) and scripts/verify_gates_fail.sh mutation checks (lines 100, 233 and the copy_perimeter check).

branches.effect: two catalogue scans; other suffixes ignored
print location (path:line, or path only when line 0), pattern, reason, snippet; return 1
